title: Link run request
description: The body of the session's POST to the run URL of its gateway's link, application/json, which opens a run: the run id the session chose, the run's labels, what the run is about, and behind a separate gateway the session's narrowing of the policy. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request: a member the gateway does not read could be a narrowing it would drop.

version.description: The document format. The gateway refuses a version it does not read.

run_id.description: The run's id, which the session chooses on both transports: a UUID in the canonical lower-case form, the subject of every event of the run. Another form is invalid_request; an id that already names a run at this gateway, live or ended, is run_id_used.

labels.description: The run's labels, as dev.qory.run.started contains them. On the local link they are the run's. Behind a separate gateway the run's labels come from the run credential alone: forge and repository must equal the credential's, else target_differs_from_credential; another label the mapping sets must equal the credential's, else differs_from_credential; a label the mapping does not set is ignored.

about.description: What the run is about, as dev.qory.run.started contains it. It selects no policy. Behind a separate gateway a key of details the mapping sets must equal the credential's, else differs_from_credential.

narrowing.description: Behind a separate gateway alone, the session's narrowing of the policy the gateway holds for the run; on the local link it is invalid_request. It can only remove what the policy allows: allow, when present, removes every host it does not cover, and deny adds to the hosts denied. The lists have the grammar of the policy's egress.allow.
